import sys

def can(n, base):
    if n == 0:
        return True
    r = n % base
    if r == 0:
        return can(n // base, base)
    if r == 1:
        return can((n - 1) // base, base)
    if r == base - 1:
        return can((n + 1) // base, base)
    return False

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w <= 3:
        print("YES")
        return
    print("YES" if can(m, w) else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
